mechanism.claim: When one completed hourly BTC return accounts for an unusually large share of a high-variation UTC day's total absolute hourly displacement, the day contains a localized information shock rather than diffuse noise. Follow the dominant shock hour's direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the earliest hour attaining the largest absolute completed hourly return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDVBR selected the maximum-volume five-minute bar and required block-return agreement. HVTVIR measured variance backloading into a fixed final three-hour window. Bipower and skew candidates measured jump magnitude or signed moments. HVDSR localizes the largest hourly return anywhere in the day and ranks its share of total absolute hourly displacement.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed-day realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one dominant-shock-conditioned 00:05 UTC daily clock is absent from Gross9

features.hourly_path: 24 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual hourly aggregates, each from 60 unique 1m bars
features.hourly_return: log(hour close/hour open), finite; at least one strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared hourly returns), strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of dominant_share and realized_variation over at most 270 prior source-valid days, minimum 180; current excluded

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after prior day completes
clock.reservation: daily opportunities are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, dominant-hour definition, rank, history, threshold, tie break, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
